step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows a CI/CD infrastructure deployment pipeline. Bitbucket (ThirdParty) triggers an API Gateway, which invokes a Lambda function to upload zip artifacts to an S3 bucket. CodeBuild is triggered by S3 object changes, inspects and filters changes, and writes updated artifacts to a second S3 bucket. This triggers CodePipeline to execute and deploy CloudFormation stacks.
